## Entries {.i-list-numbers}

Going back through a long session is a pain. The outline gives each
prompt one entry, under a heading for each day: the time, then three to
five words for what you asked. A short prompt is shown as it is. A long
one is labeled by the agent's small model, Haiku for Claude Code and
Codex's light model for Codex, in a separate session, so nothing enters
yours. Labels are made for the entries in view, a few at a time, and
kept, so each prompt is labeled once.

## Going back {.i-history}

Click an entry and the chat glides back to that round. As you scroll,
the entry in view is highlighted, so the outline always shows where you
are. It shares the left side with the [files](files.qmd): one shows at
a time, and switching does not move the chat.
